name: directory
title: Diocese of Rochester Parish Locator and Mass Times
command: pnpm diocese roster import rochester directory /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-project-carlo/7ff7c4b8-ea73-5e3f-af2b-c96f5bf7b54a/scratchpad/locator.json
notes: Scraped 2026-10-02 from the locator page's HTML table (plain WordPress, no Cloudflare): 168 rows, one per worship site under a blue header naming the parish and the diocese's site number (#N). Ids are '<site number>-<site name>' ('ind-...' for the 'Individual' block of monasteries, Newman centres and Eastern churches, which has no numbers). Badly out of date: it still lists Elmira and Rochester churches closed years ago, old domains (rc.net/rochester/stjerome), and one address in Brooklyn (St. Rose, Lima: '130 Beach 84th St, 11230, Kings'). Mass times are in notes and are often years old.
